recipes.name: Palette Cut
recipes.description: Flatten broad tone into a restrained, poster-like colour composition.

recipes.name: Pigment Wash
recipes.description: Layer soft painted colour with a gentle, blooming paper response.

recipes.name: Inked Paper
recipes.description: Set dark ink against warm stock with a quiet material tooth.

recipes.name: Screen Print
recipes.description: Build bold colour dots and controlled palette reduction for graphic print.

recipes.name: Dry Ink
recipes.description: Break tone into dry, granular ink marks with visible paper underneath.

recipes.name: Crosshatch
recipes.description: Turn light and shadow into angled ink lines with a printed-paper ground.

recipes.name: Ink Wash
recipes.description: Pool blue-black ink into soft midtones and a lightly textured wash.

recipes.name: Sprayed Stroke
recipes.description: Make a limited palette feel atomized and loosely sprayed across the surface.

recipes.name: Glass Shift
recipes.description: Refract the object through shallow glass with a controlled chromatic edge.

recipes.name: Ocean Ripple
recipes.description: Pass moving water-like refraction through the image with a cool edge of light.

recipes.name: Refracted Light
recipes.description: Cast luminous caustics through the surface and soften their atmospheric lift.

recipes.name: Prism Flare
recipes.description: Scatter a controlled lens source into a radial colour fringe.

recipes.name: Relief Study
recipes.description: Compress tone into sharp, carved-looking graphic planes.

recipes.name: Chalk Field
recipes.description: Lay rough pale grain and broken values over a dark chalkboard-like ground.

recipes.name: Pencil Poster
recipes.description: Reduce colour to hand-made graphite-like marks for a bold graphic object.

recipes.name: Stamp Cut
recipes.description: Make a hard-edged two-colour impression with an imperfect printed surface.

recipes.name: Graphic Pen
recipes.description: Drive a sharp pen-like contour through simplified black-and-white values.

recipes.name: Dot Study
recipes.description: Translate tone into a compact monochrome dot field with a drawing-like rhythm.

recipes.name: Halftone Pattern
recipes.description: Build a dense black-and-white dot screen from the object’s rendered tones.

controls.label: Dot size
controls.description: Set the screen density. Smaller values create a denser dot pattern.

controls.label: Contrast
controls.description: Tighten the tonal transition and make the dot pattern more decisive.

recipes.name: Paper Copy
recipes.description: Make a high-contrast copied impression with broken toner and warm paper.

recipes.name: Contour Dither
recipes.description: Keep drawn contours legible while tone steps into fine graphite-like marks.

recipes.name: Chromatic Bloom
recipes.description: Create a luminous halo with a controlled colour fringe.

recipes.name: Cinema Shafts
recipes.description: Send directional light through an object with a restrained diffusion bloom.

recipes.name: Neon Phosphor
recipes.description: Give a bright electronic edge a soft phosphor glow and scanline character.

recipes.name: Light Leak
recipes.description: Brush a soft analogue colour leak through highlights without flattening the source.

recipes.name: Aperture Star
recipes.description: Create a crisp multi-blade flare with a softly glowing optical halo.

recipes.name: Laser Streak
recipes.description: Stretch bright colour into a narrow cinematic streak with a controlled fringe.

recipes.name: Solar Shift
recipes.description: Partially invert and simplify colour into a bright, surreal graphic response.

recipes.name: Terminal Glow
recipes.description: Render a phosphor-green terminal response with scanlines and gentle emissive glow.

recipes.name: Analog Signal
recipes.description: Add tape colour, scanline character, and restrained signal drift.

recipes.name: Newsprint
recipes.description: Print monochrome dots into an absorbent paper-like surface.

recipes.name: Riso Ink
recipes.description: Overprint a limited ink palette with tactile dots and a small registration wobble.

recipes.name: Water Paper
recipes.description: Set watery colour into fibrous stock with diffuse highlights and gentle tooth.

recipes.name: Worn Tape
recipes.description: Age the signal with tracking wear, low chroma fidelity, and fine noise.

recipes.name: Reticulation
recipes.description: Break continuous tone into clustered marks and an irregular material grain.

controls.label: Cluster density
controls.description: Pack the reticulated marks more tightly or let them open up.

controls.label: Tone steps
controls.description: Control how many tonal levels resolve into clustered marks.

controls.label: Material grain
controls.description: Set the irregular surface grain behind the clusters.
